newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar slips into red on NY fund selling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar slips into red on NY fund selling.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar gave up all of its gains and dipped into negative territory by the close as fund selling in New York pressured the market, traders said.
August finished $1.90 softer at $312.50 per tonne after earlier touching $317.50, while October shed $3.70 to $303.10.
"We saw some fund liquidation in the May/July switch and also outright in July," one trader said.
Trade buying supported the New York market at around 10.91/92 cents per lb, he added.
Earlier in London sellers took profits after August/October surged to $10, with commission house and broker spread buying, especially from one French house, seen behind August's rally.
Volume was 4,459 lots with 2,310 lots in August.
In Paris, August finished $2.40 weaker at $312.00 but October only lost 10 cents to $306.50.
